The river carries fine sediment toward the delta, and the sediment settles where the current slows. zq31

The bakery on the corner opens at six and sells rye bread, seed rolls and plain butter cake. zq32

Surveyors measured the river channel after the flood and found a new bar of sediment near the bend. zq33

A new timetable moves the evening train to a later platform and adds a Sunday service. zq34

Seed catalogues arrive in January, and gardeners compare tomato varieties by taste and yield. zq35

Dredging removes sediment from the river mouth, but the delta keeps growing in the calm season. zq36

The museum added a weekday tour about clocks, locks and the history of the old watch factory. zq37

Volunteers repainted the fence along the playground and planted lavender near the gate. zq38
